meta.notes: Nosler: one record per Nosler part number (box-count variants such as 100/250/1000 ct are separate part numbers and therefore separate records). Primary source = the nosler.com product page "Specifications" table (BC G1, BC G7, Overall Length (OAL) (in.), Sectional Density, Diameter, Bullet Weight, Manufacturer SKU, Bullet Base/Profile/Type). The 2026 Product Guide PDF is parsed independently (pdftotext -layout, cell-by-cell by column position) and matched by part number; every numeric disagreement is kept in "conflicts" (record fields keep the product-page value). Catalog "BC." equals the product page "BC G1" for 247 of 249 matched bullets, so catalog-only records store the catalog BC as G1. Factory-seconds/blem pages, ammunition, brass and non-bullet products are excluded. Construction is assigned only where the maker's own wording (product description or the catalog page listing the part number) names it (see each record's notes). boatTailLengthIn and baseToOgiveIn are not published by Nosler (null). Swift: one record per swiftbullets.com bullet product page (Shopify; public HTML only). Swift publishes caliber, diameter, weight, profile code (as printed, e.g. AF/SS, BTS), Density (sectional density) and "Ballistic" (a ballistic coefficient without a stated drag model; kept in bcUnspecifiedModel and bcNotes, bcG1 left null). Swift publishes no bullet length, part number or twist on these pages (the JSON-LD "sku" is a Shopify variant id, not a maker part number, so sku is null). Construction comes only from the bullet collection page the product is filed under: "A-Frame® | Rifle Bullets" says "set the standard by which all bonded bullets are measured" (-> bonded); the A-Frame heavy-rifle, lever-action, revolver and muzzle-loader collection pages carry no construction wording, and the Scirocco, Break-Away, Zephyr and pistol collection pages could not be retrieved (HTTP 429), so those stay null. Swift answered request bursts with HTTP 429; downloads were slowed to 20-45 s/request and pages still missing are listed in problems. 15 records carry conflicts.
